Consumer supplies non-empty stable rowId; never source array index
Accessor/display columns unique IDs; export and aria labels
One query owner; mode-discriminated sort/filter/pagination
Stable/locale-aware client or allowlisted server sort; aria-sort only primary descriptor
Offset and cursor disjoint, known/unknown total
page/loaded/query-match typed scope with explicit confirmation
request identity, abort/stale, ready/loading/error/offline/forbidden
Mobile list/detail retains critical fields/actions
Controlled text/query, debounce only app-owned
Allowlisted operators by type; unsupported rejected
Versioned AST, AND/OR nesting budget and validation
Remove one or reset, synchronized query state
Hide/show but cannot remove all identifying fields
Serialized view reference, migration and storage consumer-owned
Explicit scope/count confirmation, app authorization
No client assumption of permission, CSV injection protection
Accessible focus-return, app-owned record loading
Actor/time/status and readable long IDs, no log backend
Split view preserves focus order
Keyboard equivalent and reconciliation to saved view
Keyboard resize, min/max, zoom/reflow test
Sticky overlays/focus and accessibility proof
Stable group IDs and typed group row semantics
Server/local accuracy and numeric precision app-owned
Focused row survival, AT alternative, benchmark
Edit/commit/cancel validation, conflict and rollback from app
Only optional engine and license approval
Preview with file limits, row errors, safe consumer backend
Job statuses, expiry, retry/cancel intent; no job engine
Shared filter/period and accessible table summaries

columnContract.identifiers: Unique stable nonempty columnId independent of translated label/header
columnContract.accessorRule: accessor reads application row path or typed accessor at runtime; functions are NEVER serialized to URL/saved view; display column cannot assume sortable or exportable

formatting.number: Intl.NumberFormat(locale,options), canonical numeric values kept separately
formatting.currency: value stored amount/minor-unit policy explicitly defined by consumer; no floating money calculation in UI

columnContract.sortFilter: Only declared capability and app/server allowlisted keys; unsupported rejected

width.minMax: min<=max; responsive content cannot disappear permanently

columnContract.aria: unique human-readable header, th/scope/headers; numeric alignment with tabular numbers; full value accessible if visually truncated
columnContract.columnSchemaMigration: Unknown persisted IDs discarded with notice; at least one identifying column visible

rowIdentity.required: getRowId(row) returns stable string (or declared server primary key) independent of position
rowIdentity.forbidden: array-index used as primary key across sorting/filter/paging/virtualization
rowIdentity.scope: Stable across page, same record across refreshed results; group IDs prefixed and isolated from record IDs
rowIdentity.onDuplicate: fatal configuration warning; disable selection/bulk/export until fixed
rowIdentity.missingId: do not manufacture ID for selection; fallback read-only presentation with visible error
rowIdentity.onDeletion: remove record from loaded display and reconcile selection by server authority

queryState.owner: consumer app; Moonframe emits intent; setQueryState wholly controlled or defaultQueryState uncontrolled with documented reset; do not switch lifetime

fields.globalSearch: string; app owns debounce and PII redaction
fields.sorting: [{columnId,descending:boolean}] allowlisted; stable tie by rowId; server ordering authoritative in server mode
fields.filters: filterAST versioned, allowed field/operator pairs, no executable predicates serialized
fields.pagination: discriminated union: {kind:'offset',pageIndex>=0,pageSize>=1,totalCount?:integer|null} OR {kind:'cursor',cursor?:opaque|null,pageSize>=1,nextCursor?:opaque|null,prevCursor?:opaque|null,totalCount?:integer|null}; forbid pageIndex with cursor
fields.density: compact|comfortable|spacious, theme/default/instance precedence external to query

invariants: No double pagination/sorting/filtering in server mode
Server mode display results as returned, do not perform hidden second pass
Changing filter/search resets offset page to 0 or cursor to null while keeping permitted sort
Sort/selection IDs must survive paging and refresh
Unknown total must stay unknown; avoid fake last page

changeRules: Controlled updates never re-emit an intent callback
One user action emits one semantic change
Async response accepted only when matching most recent request ID/query fingerprint
queryState.privacy: No auth token, user identifiers, sensitive filters in URL or persisted client cache unless consuming app explicitly approves.

filterContract.predicate: {kind:'predicate',fieldId,operator,value?}; fieldId must come from server/app allowlist, not arbitrary SQL path
filterContract.nullRule: isNull/isNotNull carry no value; null never silently equals empty string, 0 or undefined
filterContract.timezoneRule: Date-only ISO yyyy-mm-dd versus UTC instant separately typed; app/server owns inclusive/exclusive window normalization and DST.
filterContract.validation: Reject unknown field, mismatched value type, unsupported operator, incomplete ranges, excessive nesting; no raw SQL generation
filterContract.sensitive: Filter values may contain PII and must not be automatically serialized to URL/logs
filterContract.serverAdapter: Only application maps validated AST to allowlisted backend query

invariants: Select page != select all matching results
No query-all without server-issued authorized snapshot/token and explicit confirmation
Selection is not authorization; backend rechecks every ID/snapshot on mutation or export
Filter/search changes invalidate query-all; sorting/pagination may preserve explicit stable IDs if app permits
Counts distinguish loaded selected, cross-page explicit selected and all-query estimated count
Expired/permission-revoked selection becomes invalid before bulk intent

serverAdapter.kind: optional adapter interface, NOT API implementation
serverAdapter.race: Abort previous request when supported; ignore late response if requestId or queryFingerprint is stale, and preserve older data explicitly marked stale
serverAdapter.permission: Server always filters/authorizes records, columns, exports and bulk ops. Do not trust hidden UI actions.
serverAdapter.queryStateSource: Client/sort/filter/paginate entirely on complete client dataset OR server performs them; never double apply
serverAdapter.optimistic: No default implicit optimistic mutation. Consumer supplies version/conflict/rollback results.
serverAdapter.offline: No inferred connectivity from fetch status alone; show consumer-reported offline.

doNotStore: sensitive PII filter values in broadly shared views
savedViews.adapter: load/save/rename/duplicate/delete/publish intent only; backend owns permission, ETag compare and storage
savedViews.migration: Known column ID changes via app-supplied migration registry; orphan columns/filters dropped with warning, never silently broaden dataset
savedViews.sharing: Sharable URL holds safe referenced view ID, not privileged query or owner token
savedViews.localStorage: opt-in non-sensitive preferences only; cannot assume authorized cross-user saved state

allowlist: safe non-sensitive filter AST with strict length cap
urlState.parse: Versioned, length capped, validated by schema and current column allowlist; reject and recover to safe defaults, inform user
urlState.merge: URL deep-link defaults < controlled app policy; do not override current server permissions
urlState.serialization: stable key order/encoding via URLSearchParams; no implicit URL history mutation by core

exportContract.auth: Application/server reauthorizes request, row/column visibility and download; no client trust of hidden column or saved view
exportContract.scope: Visible page / loaded / selected explicit / all matching require distinct user labels, result count and confirmation
exportContract.large: Prefer consumer-owned background job for server query/full results; UI never exports unseen unauthorized data

csv.baseline: RFC4180 delimiter/CRLF/double-quote escaping, charset UTF-8 and encoding choice explicit; actual serializer not provided
csv.formulaRisk: OWASP: untrusted cell contents potentially interpreted as formulas (leading = + - @, tabs/CR/LF, separator or quote shift). Quoting alone is not reliable after spreadsheet re-save.
csv.mitigation: Future app-owned CSV serializer requires spreadsheet-tested neutralization policy per target client, formula-risk audit, defense in depth and safe alternative XLSX text-cell export; do not claim single quote/escaping always solves it

exportContract.import: P3 preview/row-error/dedupe UI only, app file scanning, validation, transaction and background processing

accessibilityContract.base: Native table semantics with caption, th/scope and actual button for sort; no role=grid unless full cell-keyboard interaction is implemented
accessibilityContract.sorting: Sort button in column header, aria-sort on correct header; announce direction and result count politely without duplicate
accessibilityContract.selection: Checkbox names use row identifying text; header checkbox scope explicitly says current page/loaded; indeterminate conveyed programmatically
accessibilityContract.paging: Keyboard reachable, current page named; announce known/unknown totals accurately
accessibilityContract.filters: Group label, applied chips removable by keyboard, invalid summary and focus return
accessibilityContract.overlays: Column chooser/row actions/detail dialog use component Bible focus restoration and escape
accessibilityContract.virtualization: No offscreen keyboard trap, AT row count/position honest, provide nonvirtual read-only alternative if needed
accessibilityContract.responsive: Mobile card/list retains label/value and every critical operation; horizontal scroll signaled and keyboard reachable
accessibilityContract.visual: 15 skin identities with same interaction; focus visible, 200%/400% zoom, forced colors, reduced motion, RTL, no color-only statuses
accessibilityContract.wcagTarget: WCAG 2.2 AA target pending real manual and browser proof

localization.canonical: Data values raw (number, ISO date-only, UTC instant, boolean) not strings formatted for UI
localization.render: Intl.NumberFormat/DateTimeFormat with explicit timeZone and options; server sort compares canonical data
localization.sort: Locale collation/case/numeric semantics specify app or server; backend consistency tested
localization.timezone: For date-only keep calendar date; for timestamp store UTC and display chosen timezone; DST boundaries application-owned
localization.rtl: Mixed-script cells isolate/bdi; align numeric according to reading needs; keyboard model tested
localization.plurals: Use locale-aware message/plural handling with unknown totals rather than hardcoded English count

performance.baseline: No benchmark yet. Illustrative fixture volumes 12/500/50000 synthetic rows; thresholds TBD from measured consumer device and target support matrix
performance.modeSelection: Use server pagination first when entire dataset cannot be loaded; virtualization optional after measurements and AT proof
stability: memoized row model only when correct
performance.bundles: Measure JS/CSS sizes before enabling large optional engine; no library selected

specificPlans.wholeAppearanceTarget: 15 canonical skins × light/dark; separate QA ledger, not rendered
specificPlans.componentTokenExceptionPolicy: table-specific tokens only after neutral semantic roles proven insufficient; no hardcoded hex or Moonledger global compact override
specificPlans.densityPrecedence: explicit instance > controlled app/user selection > skin suggested default > global safe comfortable fallback; actual theme resolution authority remains Theme Contract
